boundary: Same-owner workflow and mutation evidence only; no independent reproduction or protected-gate closure.

closeout_methods.recurrence_guard: Treat the staged-review assertion as a post-stage lifecycle check and never count a pending precommit marker as an observed witness.
closeout_methods.rollback: Leave the immutable evidence commit untouched, keep the final candidate uncommitted, and withhold closeout if any exact staged path, blob, privacy, manifest, or diff check fails.
